key_line.metric: Q4 / FY 2026 guide on US mortgage
key_line.detail: Q4 guide revenue $1.605-1.635bn, adj EPS $2.07-2.17 (mid $2.12 vs an implied ~$2.22 street Q4). FY revenue cut to $6.646-6.676bn from $6.71-6.78bn on lower US Mortgage; FY adj EPS narrowed to $8.45-8.55 (mid $8.50, down $0.04, against FY consensus $8.53). Management says the sharp late-Q3 mortgage slowdown from higher rates continues through 2026. US Mortgage revenue +15% in Q3 vs the ~20% the Q2 call guided.

guidance.detail: FY revenue lowered below the old range; FY EPS midpoint down $0.04 but inside the old range and only ~0.4% under FY consensus; implied Q4 EPS ~4.5% below the street. A modest cut, smaller than the ~80bp rate move suggested.

call.detail: Call started 08:30 ET and is running into the open; no transcript or call headlines found by 09:05 ET. Its content (bi-merge exposure, Q4 mortgage, 2027 framing) is unread here. The 170.00 last print at 08:40 ET is ten minutes into the call.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst action, wire story or press coverage of today's print was found by about 09:05 ET; searches returned only earlier quarters' pre-market stories (each of which was a sell-off on a weak guide). The only reaction is the tape: +7.2% pre-market.

tape_read.note: Last 170.00 at 08:40 ET equals the pre-market high, with zero reported volume (the source often reports none); low 158.56 is the prev close. +7.2% equals the 7.16% option-implied move and sits beside the 2025-04 +13.84% as the only large up reaction in seven prints. Market flat (SPY -0.12%). A Q3 EPS beat with a lowered FY revenue guide and a Q4 guide below the street reads as a short-covering relief rally on a name 33% down YTD where the skew paid for downside; on the release alone I would expect less than +7%, but the read rests on one round-number print and an unread call.

thesis_check.note: The thesis line confirmed: mortgage slowed, FY revenue guide cut, Q4 guide below the street. But the cut is modest (FY EPS midpoint -$0.04, near consensus) and Q3 EPS beat, and the market is treating it as 'less bad than feared' and buying it, so the trade's mechanism (a guide cut sells) has not worked.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de gedachte achter de short (lagere jaaromzet, zwakke Q4-prognose), maar de markt koopt het aandeel toch 7% hoger in, ongeveer de volledige door opties verwachte beweging. Bij ochtendcijfers loopt de koers in deze proef meestal door in de richting van de opening, en er is geen nieuws of analistenreactie die een terugval onderbouwt; daarom de short bij de opening sluiten en het verlies niet laten oplopen tot 13:00.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 duidelijk terugzakt richting 163-165 of er kopteksten komen dat het gesprek negatief uitvalt (bijvoorbeeld over hypotheken of bi-merge), dan liever tot het slot aanhouden.
